about_the_game:
🍜 Food Cart Simulator is a street food simulation game where you cook, hustle, and grow your business from the bottom up.

Start with a simple cart and basic recipes in low-income neighborhoods. Serve multiple dishes, handle rush hours, and earn tips to survive the day. As you progress, move into wealthier districts with higher rent and more demanding customers — where cheap food won’t cut it.

Upgrade your equipment as your business grows — from second-hand stoves to brand-new gear. Manage your finances, buy ingredients based on your menu, and make strategic decisions to expand your empire. Need cash? You can borrow from the bank, or take a riskier loan from a shady source to fund your next big move.

🛠️ Features:

  • 🏙️ Expanding city – sell in different districts, from backstreets to luxury areas

  • 🍲 Dynamic food system – cook and serve multiple recipes based on location demand

  • 💵 Progression through economy – earn, spend, borrow, and invest to grow

  • 🏦 Bank & Loans – borrow money from the bank or take riskier loans from less legitimate sources

  • 🛒 Suppliers & second-hand stores – buy and upgrade equipment or find deals

  • 🔄 Upgrade & sell equipment – sell old gear and invest in new tools when needed

  • 🛍️ Shopping for ingredients – purchase supplies based on your menu and location

  • ⭐ Customer satisfaction – tips and reviews that directly affect your reputation

  • 💸 Risk & reward – manage loans, take risks, and wisely invest your earnings

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GT 1050 / AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: NO
  • Additional Notes: Ray tracing features such as shadows, reflections, and ambient lighting are optional and require an NVIDIA RTX 2000 series or newer graphics card to be enabled. Additionally, DLSS is supported for improved performance on compatible NVIDIA GPUs. Upscaling technologies like AMD FSR can also be used with all supported graphics cards, including AMD RX 400 series and newer, as well as NVIDIA GTX 900 series and newer.
pc_requirements.recommended:

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060 / RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: NO
  • Additional Notes: Ray tracing features such as shadows, reflections, and ambient lighting are optional and require an NVIDIA RTX 2000 series or newer graphics card to be enabled. Additionally, DLSS is supported for improved performance on compatible NVIDIA GPUs. Upscaling technologies like AMD FSR can also be used with all supported graphics cards, including AMD RX 400 series and newer, as well as NVIDIA GTX 900 series and newer.

short_description: Cook, hustle, and rise in Food Cart Simulator! Start with a humble food cart, serve up delicious meals, and upgrade your gear to expand. Manage loans, buy supplies, and survive the streets — but be careful who you borrow from! Can you build your street food empire?
supported_languages: English, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Turkish
